fahrzeug.title: EV Assistant - Vehicle
fahrzeug.description: Step 1/9: Vehicle details. Usable battery capacity: the value actually available for driving/charging — NOT the larger gross/factory spec (e.g. 58 kWh gross, but only 52 kWh usable). This value directly determines how many kWh one SoC percentage point equals — if entered incorrectly, all energy estimates will be wrong.

modus.title: EV Assistant - Charging Mode
modus.description: Step 2/9: How do you charge your vehicle? Only determines which of the following steps and which panel tabs/cards are shown — the calculations themselves don't change (a pure external charger is simply the case where the home values are 0). "Away only" hides the evcc/wallbox step and the home-charging cards in the panel; "Home only" and "Mixed" continue exactly as before. Changeable again at any time via Configure, without losing any already-recorded data.

evcc.title: EV Assistant - evcc & Wallbox
evcc.description: Step 3/9: Wallbox and site entities (charge power, PV, grid, tariffs, statistics) are automatically imported from the evcc integration. Only needed here: the vehicle name in evcc (filters home-charging history) and the power entity of your wallbox. The wallbox power entity is used ONLY for yes/no detection of 'currently charging at home' (not an energy value, and it naturally only reports anything while at home) — without it, every SoC increase will be incorrectly classified as external charging. For energy measurement during external charging, see step 4 (vehicle charge power, from vehicle telemetry).

data_description.home_entity: Just a yes/no threshold (>0.1 kW = 'currently charging at home') — not an energy value, and only reports anything while the vehicle is plugged into this wallbox.

ladeleistung.title: EV Assistant - Charge Power
ladeleistung.description: Step 4/9: optional vehicle charge power and wallbox energy measurement. The vehicle charge power improves energy estimates for external charging sessions — unlike the wallbox power entity from step 3, it comes from vehicle telemetry and therefore also reports values away from your own wallbox. The wallbox energy meter is a cumulative kWh counter and is only evaluated during home charging: it calibrates the real charging efficiency from it (which then replaces the initial value from step 1, e.g. for SoC-based estimates during external charging) and, with variable tariffs, weights the home electricity price for step 9 by the amount actually charged.

data.power_is_ac: Charge power is AC-side (charge point) not DC-side (battery)

data_description.power_is_ac: Only relevant if a vehicle charge power sensor is set above — without it, this setting has no effect.
data_description.wallbox_energy_entity: Only active during home charging: calibrates the real charging efficiency from it (replaces the initial value from step 1) and weights the home electricity price for step 8 by the amount actually charged.

ausgabe.title: EV Assistant - Notifications
ausgabe.description: Step 5/9: push target devices and what triggers a notification. A notification in the HA 'Notifications' area ALWAYS appears automatically for external charging, trips, and Tankerkönig outages, regardless of the selection below — the selected notify target devices additionally receive a push (e.g. to your phone), but only for the events selected here. SoC thresholds only trigger a push and apply to any charging session in progress, whether at home or away.

data_description.notify_entities: One or more notify entities (phone, tablet, email, ...). Without a selection, you only get the notification in the HA 'Notifications' area, no push.
data_description.notify_events: Only controls whether a push is additionally sent to the notify target devices above — the notification in the HA 'Notifications' area always appears for external charging/trips/Tankerkönig regardless.
data_description.soc_thresholds: Only triggers a push if 'SoC threshold reached' is selected above and at least one notify target device is set. Applies to any charging session in progress (home or external).

erkennung.title: EV Assistant - Detection
erkennung.description: Step 6/9: fine-tuning of external charging detection. Default values work for most cases. Flow: charging starts when SoC rises by the start threshold; ends on SoC drop below the peak or after timeout. SoC noise must ALWAYS be smaller than the start threshold. Optional: a plug sensor detects charge end/continuation directly instead of via the timeout — a confirmed “plugged in” prevents a split when SoC is reported coarsely, a confirmed “unplugged” ends immediately. To guard against brief false readings from the source, a change must hold for the debounce time.

data.start_delta: Start threshold (%, minimum SoC rise to count as charging)
data.noise: SoC noise (%, tolerance — must be smaller than the start threshold!)

fahrtenbuch.title: EV Assistant - Trip Log
fahrtenbuch.description: Step 7/9: fine-tuning of automatic trip detection, which uses the same odometer sensor from step 1. Default values work for most cases. Optional: a motor/driving sensor (e.g. ignition/"Ready") adds a second signal for vehicles whose odometer updates too coarsely/infrequently to derive trip start/end from it directly — distance is still always taken from the odometer. An optional outside temperature entity (weather integration or sensor) groups consumption by temperature band, making the estimated range winter-proof once enough trips are logged.

data.gps_entity: Location suggestion (person, device_tracker, or sensor entity)
data.trip_auto_confirm: Automatically add trips to the log (without manual confirmation)
data.usage_profile_buffer_pct: Buffer for usage profile (%, on the weekday average)
data.pv_forecast_entity: PV forecast for tomorrow (optional, any sensor entity, e.g. Solcast/Forecast.Solar)
data.outside_temp_entity: Outside temperature (optional, weather integration or sensor — for temperature-aware consumption/range estimation)

leasing.title: EV Assistant - Leasing Mileage Budget
leasing.description: Step 8/9: optional leasing mileage budget, all fields optional. Uses the same odometer sensor from step 1 — no extra sensor needed. Becomes active once both the contract end date and the total included km are set; without both, the whole feature (sensors, panel tab) stays inactive. Under-mileage credit is only shown if a refund price is entered — many contracts don't refund it at all, or only up to a cap.

data.leasing_inkl_km: Total included km over the contract term
data.leasing_preis_minder_km: Refund per under-driven km (EUR/km, optional — only if the contract provides for it)

vergleich.title: EV Assistant - Cost Comparison
vergleich.description: Step 9/9: Optional cost comparison against a combustion vehicle. All fields optional. Home-charging costs require a wallbox energy meter from step 4. Fuel price priority: Tankerkönig fuel type (automatic, cheapest open station) > entity > fixed value — configure only one source.

data.home_price_entity: Home electricity price entity (overrides fixed price)
data.tankerkoenig_fuel_type: Fuel type for Tankerkönig auto-detection (overrides entity/fixed price with the cheapest open station)
data.co2_per_kwh_g: Grid CO2 intensity (g/kWh, for the CO2 comparison)

error.noise_too_high: The SoC noise value must be smaller than the start threshold.

abort.already_configured: A vehicle is already configured for this SoC entity.

entity_unavailable_soc_entity.title: Vehicle SOC unavailable
entity_unavailable_soc_entity.description: The configured entity `{entity_id}` has been unavailable/unknown or removed from Home Assistant for at least {minuten} minutes. While this persists, external-charge and charging-efficiency detection get no new SoC values and keep working off stale data. Check the source integration/sensor (e.g. connectivity, restart it).

entity_unavailable_odo_entity.title: Odometer unavailable
entity_unavailable_odo_entity.description: The configured entity `{entity_id}` has been unavailable/unknown or removed from Home Assistant for at least {minuten} minutes. While this persists, trip detection stalls and all odometer statistics/projections keep showing the last known figures.

entity_unavailable_plug_entity.title: Plug sensor unavailable
entity_unavailable_plug_entity.description: The configured entity `{entity_id}` has been unavailable/unknown or removed from Home Assistant for at least {minuten} minutes. External-charge detection falls back to plain timeout logic in the meantime instead of detecting plug-in/unplug directly.

entity_unavailable_motor_entity.title: Motor/driving sensor unavailable
entity_unavailable_motor_entity.description: The configured entity `{entity_id}` has been unavailable/unknown or removed from Home Assistant for at least {minuten} minutes. Trip detection relies solely on the odometer in the meantime.

entity_unavailable_home_entity.title: Wallbox charge power unavailable
entity_unavailable_home_entity.description: The configured entity `{entity_id}` has been unavailable/unknown or removed from Home Assistant for at least {minuten} minutes. The yes/no detection of "currently charging at home" is out in the meantime — a SoC increase could be incorrectly classified as an external charge.

entity_unavailable_power_entity.title: Vehicle charge power unavailable
entity_unavailable_power_entity.description: The configured entity `{entity_id}` has been unavailable/unknown or removed from Home Assistant for at least {minuten} minutes. The energy estimate for an external charge falls back to the plain SoC-delta estimate in the meantime.

entity_unavailable_wallbox_energy_entity.title: Wallbox energy meter unavailable
entity_unavailable_wallbox_energy_entity.description: The configured entity `{entity_id}` has been unavailable/unknown or removed from Home Assistant for at least {minuten} minutes. Charging-efficiency calibration and home-charging price weighting are paused in the meantime.

entity_unavailable_gps_entity.title: Location suggestion entity unavailable
entity_unavailable_gps_entity.description: The configured entity `{entity_id}` has been unavailable/unknown or removed from Home Assistant for at least {minuten} minutes. New trips get no automatic start/end location suggestion in the meantime (still correctable afterwards via edit_trip).

entity_unavailable_home_price_entity.title: Home electricity price entity unavailable
entity_unavailable_home_price_entity.description: The configured entity `{entity_id}` has been unavailable/unknown or removed from Home Assistant for at least {minuten} minutes. The home electricity price falls back to the last known or fixed value in the meantime.

entity_unavailable_verbrenner_price_enti.title: Fuel price entity unavailable
entity_unavailable_verbrenner_price_enti.description: The configured entity `{entity_id}` has been unavailable/unknown or removed from Home Assistant for at least {minuten} minutes. The fuel price falls back to the last known or fixed value in the meantime (unless a Tankerkönig fuel type is configured, which takes priority anyway).
